races.paceDynamic: He Can't Dance and Papagei will contest the early lead, with Love Safari likely tracking prominently behind them. This creates an honest gallop throughout the 2m6f trip, but with only two confirmed front-runners the pace shouldn't be suicidal, allowing the large contingent of hold-up horses to get competitive from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If He Can't Dance and Papagei burn each other out in a sustained battle
scenarios.body: The pace setters weaken turning for home, opening the door for the hold-up brigade. Carniny or Kashchei can time their challenges perfectly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Love Safari gets the perfect trip tracking the leaders without getting involved early
scenarios.body: Love Safari can use her prominent style to strike when the front pair weaken, having saved energy in the early stages. Her decent rating of OR120 tells against weaker opposition.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner stays tough
scenarios.trigger: If He Can't Dance or Papagei gets an uncontested lead or soft fractions early
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back up the hill, with He Can't Dance's superior rating and proven soft ground form giving him the edge. The hold-up horses leave it too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden surprise package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced newcomers has been working better than their profile suggests
scenarios.body: Clone Cross, Robertjames or The Poet's Way could have significantly more ability than their profiles indicate. Their unknown quantities status makes them dangerous in a competitive maiden.

watchPoints.text: He Can't Dance could get an easy lead if Papagei doesn't go with him early, making him very hard to catch

races.paceDynamic: Robindevidastar and Toor Moon will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. This should create an honest pace throughout, suiting the army of hold-up horses who can time their challenges late. The soft ground and extended trip favor patient tactics, making this a proper test of stamina where positioning will be crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go too fast early and weaken
scenarios.body: The front pair will have burned each other out by halfway, leaving the race to the patient hold-up horses with the strongest finishing kicks. Ocean Murphy or Saunton Surf can capitalize with their superior class ratings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Robindevidastar or Toor Moon get tactical respite
scenarios.body: One leader will drop back slightly after the initial battle, then sustain their effort better than expected to hold off the late challenge. The honest pace will have stretched the field enough to prevent a cavalry charge finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is even but not excessive
scenarios.body: The gallop will be solid but not suicidal, allowing the highest-rated hold-up horses to mount their challenges with enough gas in the tank. Ocean Murphy, Kalsman and Let's Go Mans have the class edge when the whips are cracking.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gets an easy time in front
scenarios.body: Either Robindevidastar or Toor Moon will get loose without serious pressure, building an unassailable lead while the hold-up brigade leaves it too late. The soft ground will make ground hard to make up from the back.

watchPoints.text: Let's Go Mans has won impressively on heavy going but all his best form is on good ground.

Marine Ranger and Jimli's Cave are the only prominent runners who might resist the front pair early.
Ocean Murphy has very limited soft ground experience for such a well-regarded stayer.

scenarios.body: The front-runner dictates fractions and has enough left to resist late challengers on ground that suits. Hold-up horses struggle to organize their runs in time with the pace being genuine but not destructive.

scenarios.trigger: If the large pack of hold-up horses get bunched turning in with limited room

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If Splashing Out gets a clear run despite the traffic and the pace has been testing enough
scenarios.body: The class horse unleashes his superior rating with a devastating late run that mows down the leaders. Other hold-up horses also benefit from the strong pace but lack his finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Positioning Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If Gamigin or Coolboy Christy avoid the worst traffic by tracking closer than usual
scenarios.body: One of the hold-up specialists gets the perfect trip by being patient but not too far back. They thread through gaps as leaders tire and other closers remain trapped.

races.paceDynamic: Uncle Pat will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners in the field, allowing him to dictate a comfortable tempo through the early stages. The prominent brigade of Slanagaibhgoleir, Fishery Lane, Brideswell Lad, Money Heist, and Shannon Royale will track behind in second-flight positions, while the large hold-up contingent including Rexem, Born Braver, and Dorans Law will need the pace to collapse late. This setup creates a sustainable gallop that may not provide enough early pressure to soften up the leaders for the back-markers.

scenarios.body: He dictates fractions unchallenged and kicks clear approaching the final fence with enough left to resist late challenges. The prominent runners struggle to peg him back having tracked a steady tempo throughout.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly run and the leaders weaken significantly in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: Rexem and Born Braver find clear runs through beaten horses and power home with their superior finishing kicks. The front division pays the price for early exertions over this marathon trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Outsider Strike
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or interference disrupts the main contenders
scenarios.body: The race develops into a war of attrition with several market leaders taken out of contention. One of the outsiders like Beggars Rock or I A Connect capitalizes on the chaos to claim victory at big odds.
